links.plain: side familiarity sensor firing a false match on a look-alike room layout
links.function: signals gut-level familiarity when spatial geometry or word themes echo a forgotten past experience
links.narration_bridge: Generates the initial rhinal familiarity spark documented in Cleary et al. (2009, SRC2) and Bartolomei et al. (2012, SRC5).

links.plain: deep memory vault staying quiet because you were never truly here before
links.function: searches episodic memory records and returns zero true recollection during artificial déjà vu
links.narration_bridge: Remained notably unactivated during fMRI déjà vu trials in Urquhart & O'Connor (2021, SRC1).

links.plain: conflict alarm flagging the clash between eerie familiarity and brand-new facts
links.function: detects the sharp mismatch between rising temporal familiarity and zero hippocampal recall
links.narration_bridge: Lit up robustly in 16 of 21 scanned participants experiencing déjà vu in Urquhart & O'Connor (2021, SRC1).

links.plain: forehead reality-checker vetoing the false alarm before it becomes a fake memory
links.function: audits and overrides erroneous familiarity so you know the moment is genuinely new
links.narration_bridge: Explains why frontal intactness produces healthy déjà vu while frontal damage yields persistent déjà vécu (Moulin 2017, SRC4; Urquhart & O'Connor 2021, SRC1).
